summary.text: Mark Finchem is a Republican member of the Arizona Senate for District 1, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: In a candidate statement in the 2024 voter guide, Finchem described 21 years as a firefighter and paramedic followed by 18 years as a law enforcement officer.
The same statement says Finchem was elected to the Arizona House of Representatives in 2014 and served eight years there.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 1 (candidate-submitted statements)
